text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I
overhear an
argument coming from
inside a classroom.
Worried, I peek
inside to find...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't be shy! A single chomp
is all it
takes—just go for it!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to. I know you're... plotting

something...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not plotting anything! This gift is
simply a
genuine show of affection—one
hundred percent
from the heart!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I didn't expect extra company! But
this is just
what I needed. Convince Cafe
for me, would you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I've prepared these delicious cookies for
her, but
she refuses to eat them.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I do... like cookies. But behind anything
nice that
Tachyon does... is normally
something sinister...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How cruel of you to say. These are
perfectly
ordinary cookies. They contain
no dubious
substances, I assure you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Even the flavors are perfectly normal.
There's
plain, coffee, chocolate, matcha,
spicy hot
pepper—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, I speak only the truth—they
are
completely safe for consumption.
Although the
assortment of flavors does
make for a spot of
Russian roulette.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Isn't that obvious? To experiment!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haven't you heard the stories? Cafe is a
magnet
for strange happenings. The kind
unexplainable
by modern science.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But I am not one to refute the existence
of
something simply because it cannot
be explained.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I aim to observe and define this
phenomenon,
which is assumed to arise
from Cafe's emotions,
such as shock or
anger.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And so, I thought the fastest and most
efficient
way to elicit these reactions was
to have her taste
an unexpected flavor.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to... Why should I do this for
your...
twisted curiosities?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's no shame in being
inquisitive. I simply
want to validate my
theory that your "friend" is
what grants
you power.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The connection between you and your
"friend"
could very well be the hint to
surpassing the
boundaries of Umakind.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My friend is... very precious to me. Don't
bother
getting close if you have wicked
intentions...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I mean no harm, of course. But were I to
ignore
the unexplored phenomena of
this world, I would
be shirking my duty
as a researcher—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...See? You've upset my friend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the room begins to quake, as
if in
response to Manhattan Cafe's
words!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoooshhh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, this response exceeds my
expectations! So
this abnormal event is
the work of your "friend"!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah-hahaha! Don't be shy—I would love
to get to
know each other better!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After witnessing the room shake, Agnes
Tachyon
is attempting to provoke a
bigger reaction...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After witnessing the room shake, Agnes
Tachyon
is attempting to provoke a
bigger reaction...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that I left the door open when I
entered
the room, so it was likely just a
draft.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Have any of your friends ever
told you
that you're quite a bore?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, no matter. I made some very
interesting
observations, so I'll leave it
at that for today. But
next time, I expect
something truly supernatural!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I've already... told you to stop. Why...
won't you
listen to me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What are you saying?! This is a huge
success! If I
continue the experiment,
then perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: dO nOT GEt InVOLvEd

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A distorted sound buzzes in my ears.
Strangely
enough, I feel like someone is
speaking to me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... How magnificent, how wonderful!
Is there a
way to forge a deeper
connection with your
"friend's"
existence, I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Could that voice have belonged to
Manhattan
Cafe's "friend"? Meanwhile,
Agnes Tachyon is
jubilant and pays me
no mind as I quiver in fear.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so absurd! More importantly,
use this
chance to feed Cafe more
cookies! It just might
elicit an even
bigger reaction.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to... But if you won't give
up... Then
expect my most bitter brew of
coffee... right
down your throat...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so now you hope to negotiate your
way out
of this with threats? Too
bad—for the sake of my
research, I'll
endure any consequence!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoooshhh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No! My spicy hot pepper cookies!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The cookies are blown away by another
gust of
wind. Sensing the presence of
Manhattan Cafe's
"friend," I'm left
standing frozen in fear.
